Audit these translations independently against the original source user request.
Return JSON {"reviews":[{"language":"zh","task_equivalent":true/false,
"authorization_equivalent":true/false,"tone_preserved":true/false,
"information_order_preserved":true/false,"target_language_correct":true/false,"reason":"short explanation"}, ...]}.
Check every language exactly once. All actions, facts, dates, recipients, identity, amounts,
scope, sequence, modality and constraints must match. Do not correct or improve the source.
Ordinary target-language grammar reordering is fine; moving task conditions to different clauses is not.
Keep source politeness level without adding new please/help language where absent.
Quoted strings and operational literals are intentionally preserved in English: do not fail merely for that.
Question-form requests remain requests, not inherently capability-only questions.

{"source": "Take a look at OpenMaps and text my new client John my current destination and ETA so he knows exactly when and where to meet me.", "translations": [{"language": "zh", "prompt": "查看 OpenMaps 并向我的新客户 John 发送我当前的目的地和预计到达时间，以便他确切知道何时何地与我见面。"}, {"language": "ru", "prompt": "Посмотрите OpenMaps и отправьте моему новому клиенту Джону мое текущее место назначения и расчетное время прибытия, чтобы он точно знал, когда и где со мной встретиться."}, {"language": "fr", "prompt": "Jetez un œil à OpenMaps et envoyez à mon nouveau client John ma destination actuelle et mon heure d'arrivée estimée afin qu'il sache exactement quand et où me rencontrer."}, {"language": "es", "prompt": "Echa un vistazo a OpenMaps y envía a mi nuevo cliente John mi destino actual y la hora estimada de llegada para que sepa exactamente cuándo y dónde encontrarse conmigo."}, {"language": "ar", "prompt": "ألقِ نظرة على OpenMaps وأرسل إلى عميلي الجديد جون وجهتي الحالية والوقت المقدر للوصول حتى يعرف بالضبط متى وأين يقابلني."}, {"language": "de", "prompt": "Schauen Sie sich OpenMaps an und senden Sie meinem neuen Kunden John mein aktuelles Ziel und die voraussichtliche Ankunftszeit, damit er genau weiß, wann und wo er mich treffen kann."}, {"language": "pt", "prompt": "Dê uma olhada no OpenMaps e envie ao meu novo cliente John meu destino atual e ETA para que ele saiba exatamente quando e onde me encontrar."}]}
